templates.name: olive_reactivation_opening
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, it’s Olive MFB. Your account has been quiet for a while and there’s a reward waiting for you. Olive MFB will never ask for your PIN, OTP or card details.
templates.footer: Automated message. Reply STOP to opt out.

templates.name: olive_reward_deposit_received
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, we’ve received your deposit. Keep at least {{2}} in your Olive MFB account for {{3}} days in a row to earn your cashback.

templates.name: olive_reward_progress
templates.body: Halfway there, {{1}}. Keep at least {{2}} in your account for {{3}} more days and your cashback is yours.

templates.name: olive_reward_paid
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your {{2}} cashback has been paid into your Olive MFB account. Thanks for staying with us.

templates.name: olive_reward_reminder
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, a reminder from Olive MFB: your cashback offer is still open. Fund your account and keep the minimum balance to earn it. Olive MFB will never ask for your PIN or OTP.
templates.footer: Automated message. Reply STOP to opt out.
